title: Logspace membership of the acceptance language
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, the language of paired encodings of inputs, certificates, and space-bounded accepting configurations for $N$ is decidable in logarithmic space.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
